ArmCommand: Command for one arm. It is used as right_arm_command or left_arm_command in a BodyComponentBasedCommand.
BatteryInfo: Battery information in RobotInfo (no fields in this version).
BatteryState: Battery voltage, current and charge level.
BodyCommand: Command for the upper body: the torso and both arms together. Use body_component_based_command to give the torso and each arm its own command.
BodyComponentBasedCommand: Separate commands for the right arm, the left arm and the torso, executed together.
CartesianCommand: Cartesian pose targets with optional joint position targets.
CartesianImpedanceControlCommand: Cartesian impedance control with pose targets, optional joint and null-space targets, and joint limit settings.
Collision: One pair of links that are close to each other or in collision, with the closest points and their distance.
CommandHeader: Header of every command. The request sets the control hold time; the feedback reports whether the command has finished.
CommonError: Error code and message, set in a ResponseHeader when the request failed.
ComponentBasedCommand: Separate commands for the mobile base (mobility), the upper body (body) and the head, executed together. Each part is optional.
ControlManagerService: Enables and disables the Control Manager, resets faults, cancels the running control, sets the time scale and waits until the robot is ready for commands.
ControlManagerState: State of the Control Manager: its state, control state, time scale, enabled joints and whether unlimited mode is on.
EMOInfo: Name of an emergency stop (EMO) input, in RobotInfo.
EMOState: State of one emergency stop (EMO) input.
FTSensorData: Force and torque measured by a force/torque sensor, and the time since its last update.
FileService: Downloads a file from the robot PC (RPC) as a stream of chunks.
Gamepad: Gamepad button and joystick values. The UploadGamepadData RPC takes a stream of these messages.
GamepadService: Streams gamepad button and joystick data to the robot.
GravityCompensationCommand: Free-drive (hand-guiding) mode for the selected joints: position feedback is faded out, so the joints can be moved by hand and do NOT hold their pose against external forces or payloads. When the command ends (control hold time expires or it is cancelled), position feedback fades back in and the joints hold the pose they are in at that moment.
GripperInitializationRequest: Initialize a gripper by name and prepare it for motion.
GripperMoveRequest: Move a gripper to a target position with velocity/force limits.
GripperMoveResponse: Result of a gripper move request.
HeadCommand: Command for the head joints (joint position control).
ImpedanceControlCommand: Cartesian impedance control of one link toward a target pose (T), relative to a reference link.
Inertial: Mass, center of mass and inertia tensor of a link.
JogCommand: Single-joint jog command for absolute, relative, or step motion.
JointGroupPositionCommand: Position targets for a named joint subset.
JointImpedanceControlCommand: Joint-space impedance control with stiffness/damping settings.
JointInfo: Static information about one joint: name, brake, motor product and firmware version.
JointOperationService: Low-level joint operations: servo on and off, brakes, home offset, position PID gains and preset position. These calls act on the motor drivers directly, not through robot commands.
JointPositionCommand: Joint-space position targets with optional velocity/acceleration limits.
JointState: State of one joint: status flags, position, velocity, current, torque, the last target and the motor temperature.
JointVelocityCommand: Joint-space velocity targets with optional acceleration limits.
Log: One log entry of the robot program, with its level and time stamps.
LogService: Reads the robot program log (last entries or a live stream), sets the log level and lists fault logs.
MobilityCommand: Command for the mobile base: wheel joint velocities or a planar (SE2) velocity.
OptimalControlCommand: Whole-body optimal control with weighted task objectives.
ParameterService: Reads, sets and resets the robot parameters.
PositionPIDGain: Position PID gains of one joint motor driver.
PowerInfo: Name of a power output, in RobotInfo.
PowerService: Turns power outputs on and off, sends joint commands (servo on, brakes, home offset) and sets the tool flange power.
PowerState: State and voltage of one power output.
Quaternion: Rotation as a quaternion (x, y, z, w).
RealTimeControlCommand: Starts a real-time control session. The request carries only the UDP `port`: the robot and the client then exchange robot state and joint commands over UDP on that port, not through this message. In the C++ SDK, `Robot::Control()` runs this loop.
RobotCommand: A command for the robot. The request selects whole-body, component-based or jog control; the feedback reports the status and the finish code.
RobotCommandRequest: RPC request wrapper for sending a robot command with priority.
RobotCommandResponse: RPC response wrapper for a robot command.
RobotCommandService: Sends robot commands: one command with RobotCommand, or a continuous stream of commands with RobotCommandStream.
RobotInfo: Static information about the robot: versions, model, joints, power outputs, EMO inputs and the joint index of each component.
RobotInfoService: Returns the robot information and the robot model, and imports a robot model.
RobotState: Full state of the robot at one time: system, battery, power, EMO, joint and sensor states, odometry, center of mass and collisions. Arrays with one value per joint use the robot joint order (see RobotInfo).
RobotStateService: Returns the robot state once or as a stream, returns the Control Manager state and resets the odometry.
SerialConnectionStatus: Result of opening a serial device.
SerialDeviceInfo: Path and description of a serial device on the robot PC (RPC).
SerialOpenRequest: Opens a serial device: path, baud rate and frame format. Sent in an OpenSerialStreamRequest.
SerialService: Lists the serial devices on the robot PC (RPC) and opens a two-way stream to one of them.
SerialWriteRequest: Data to write to the open serial device. Sent in an OpenSerialStreamRequest.
StopCommand: Controlled stop of the whole robot: all joints decelerate to zero velocity within the default joint acceleration limits, then the robot holds still for the control hold time.
SystemService: System settings of the robot PC (RPC): system time, battery level and configuration, network reset and Wi-Fi.
SystemStat: CPU and memory usage and uptime of the robot PC (RPC).
ToolFlangeService: Sets the digital outputs of a tool flange.
ToolFlangeState: State of a tool flange: IMU (gyro and acceleration), switch, output voltage and digital inputs and outputs.
TorsoCommand: Command for the torso joints. The request selects one control mode.
UploadGamepadDataRequest: Gamepad data with a request header.
WholeBodyCommand: Command for all joints of the robot at once: a stop command or a real-time control session.
WifiNetwork: A Wi-Fi network found by a scan: SSID, signal strength and whether it is secured.
